title: Personalized Acrylic Desk Sign with Wooden Stand, Custom Engraved Name
description:
Create a clear, personal place on your desk with a custom engraved acrylic name sign. Its minimalist layout keeps your chosen name easy to read, and the included wooden stand holds the sign upright.

WHAT YOU RECEIVE
One clear acrylic sign measuring 8 × 3 inches and one wooden stand. Decorative items in styled photos are not included.

PERSONALIZATION
Enter the name exactly as you want it engraved, including capitalization. Maximum 24 characters. Example: Olivia. Check spelling before ordering.

DETAILS
Clear acrylic sign with a wooden stand. Minimalist engraved name. Sign size: 8 × 3 inches, excluding the stand.

PROCESSING AND SHIPPING
Made to order and dispatched from the United States in 3–5 business days. Shipping within the United States costs $5. Carrier transit is separate from processing; an arrival date has not been confirmed.

RETURNS
Returns and exchanges are not offered under this seller's selected shop policy. Contact the seller about an order issue.
